observations.what: Sign-up is a three-step wizard (account, company with website + company name, about you) and the third step requires a phone number before the account can be created.
The final sign-up step shows a visible reCAPTCHA checkbox that opened a challenge and had to be solved before 'Create account' would submit.
After 'Create account' the site dropped me on the login page (login?next=/dashboard) instead of into the app, and a 'Confirm your Klaviyo email' message arrived that had to be clicked first.
Logging in after confirming the email requires another reCAPTCHA, which escalated to image-grid challenges (bicycles, fire hydrants) that could not be cleared, so the dashboard was never reached.
The '+' alias email was accepted by both the sign-up form and the confirmation flow, so plus-addressing was not the blocker.
My first click aimed at the reCAPTCHA checkbox landed on 'Forgot your password?' after the layout shifted, costing steps on the reset page.
My helper script in the shared scratchpad was overwritten by a parallel run, causing one wasted wait step.
